hazards.name: Wildfire
hazards.tip: Check fire alerts before hiking; leave early if told to evacuate.
hazards.probability: There is greater than a 50% chance of encountering weather that could support a significant wildfire that is likely to result in both life and property loss in any given year.

hazards.name: Water scarcity
hazards.tip: Water shortages possible; carry bottled water.
hazards.probability: There is up to a 20% chance droughts will occur in the coming 10 years.

hazards.name: Extreme heat
hazards.tip: Plan activities for early morning/evening; hydrate; watch for heat stroke.
hazards.probability: There is more than a 25% chance that at least one period of prolonged exposure to extreme heat, resulting in heat stress, will occur in the next five years.

hazards.name: River flood
hazards.tip: Avoid riverbanks and low ground after heavy rain.
hazards.probability: There is a chance of more than 1% that potentially damaging and life-threatening river floods occur in the coming 10 years (return period of c. 1 in 1000 years).

hazards.name: Landslide
hazards.tip: Avoid steep slopes, mountain roads and hillside stays during heavy rain.
hazards.probability: This area has rainfall patterns, terrain slope, geology, soil, land cover and (potentially) earthquakes that make localized landslides an uncommon hazard phenomenon.

hazards.name: Urban flood
hazards.tip: Streets can flood fast in downpours; don't walk or drive through water.

hazards.name: Earthquake
hazards.tip: Know 'drop, cover, hold on'; choose modern, well-built accommodation.

hazards.name: Coastal flood
hazards.tip: Storm surge possible; know the route to higher ground from your hotel.

hazards.name: Tsunami
hazards.tip: Learn the evacuation route; strong or long shaking = go to high ground.
